about.label: About Me
about.title: I'm passionate about creating digital solutions
about.short: I'm Almond, an IT student who enjoys designing interfaces, building websites and making data easy to understand.
long: I'm studying Information Technology, where I'm learning everything from UI/UX design and web development to databases and data visualization.
I care about clean code, clear design and details that make a website feel easy to use. This portfolio collects the projects and skills I'm building along the way.

timeline.detail: Studying web development, databases, UI/UX design and data visualization.
Learned user-centered design, wireframes and prototyping for apps and websites.
Turning raw data into clear charts and dashboards that tell a story.
Designing ER diagrams and relational databases, and writing SQL queries.
Researched and presented a community issue: PM2.5 air pollution in Bangkok.
